Compiled for browser/module worker/Node; memory growth enabled; no pthreads.
No eval or new Function in the vendored runtime. Loaded only for TIFF conversion.
No npm install, CDN, server processing or remote image upload at runtime.

The three user reference pairs were tested locally (15,122,338 pixels).
RGB->CMYK with original ICC profiles, relative colorimetric and flags 8448
(BLACKPOINTCOMPENSATION | NOOPTIMIZE) matched the diagnostic Pillow/
LittleCMS 2.18 output byte-for-byte. This is not proof of universal equality
with Adobe ACE or of physical printing fidelity.
